channel.title: SleepMedic Blog
channel.description: Evidence-based sleep science for shift workers, first responders, and busy humans. Weekly posts on circadian health, recovery, and rest.

item.title: Eat on Day Hours, Even When You Work Nights
item.description: A 2025 randomized trial fed two groups identical food and changed only the hour. The daytime eaters avoided circadian misalignment entirely. Here is what a night worker does with that.

item.title: Sleep Protection, Not Sleep Advice
item.description: Shift workers do not have a sleep information problem. They know what to do. What they lack is a way to defend the window against a schedule, a family, and a world that runs on a clock they do not live by.

item.title: The Nap Menu
item.description: Napping isn't what you do because you failed to sleep properly. It's a skill, and the people who take it seriously tend to be the ones with the most on the line.

item.title: The Split Nap
item.description: Ninety minutes plus thirty matched a single two-hour nap across a simulated night shift. For anyone whose break never comes in one piece, that changes the math.

item.title: Why Deep Sleep Evades You in Perimenopause and How to Find It
item.description: Feeling restless, anxious, and drained in perimenopause? Discover the hidden hormonal shifts beyond hot flashes and implement targeted strategies to reclaim restorative deep sleep.

item.title: Are You a True Night Owl or Just Misaligned?
item.description: Feeling wired at 2 AM? Discover if your late nights are a true biological chronotype or a schedule mismatch. Stop blaming yourself and find your rhythm.

item.title: Conquer Morning Brain Fog: Stop Sleep Inertia Fast
item.description: Waking up groggy, despite enough sleep? This 'sleep drunkenness' isn't just annoying; it's a real neurological state. Uncover its science and beat it.

item.title: How to Quiet Racing Thoughts at 2 AM: The Cognitive Shuffling Method
item.description: Racing thoughts keeping you awake? Cognitive shuffling offers a science-backed way to interrupt anxious loops, guiding your mind to sleep without screens or medication.

item.title: Why Your Sleep Still Fails After a Viral Illness: The Hidden Mechanisms
item.description: Persistent exhaustion despite sleeping after a viral infection like Long COVID is frustrating. Discover the science behind disrupted deep sleep and circadian rhythms, and how to reclaim restorative rest.

item.title: Low Sleep Tracker Score? What to Change Tonight.
item.description: Frustrated by cryptic sleep tracker scores? Learn to translate 'low REM' or 'poor quality' into immediate, actionable steps to improve your sleep, starting tonight.

item.title: How to Get Functional Sleep with a Newborn
item.description: Fragmented sleep with a newborn feels impossible. Learn science-backed strategies like micro-napping and strategic rest to reclaim energy and mental clarity.

item.title: L-theanine, GABA, Ashwagandha: What Clinical Trials Show for Anxiety & Sleep
item.description: Tired of restless nights and constant worry? We unpack the clinical evidence behind L-theanine, GABA, and Ashwagandha for stress and sleep.

item.title: What Can I Eat on Night Shift to Stop Bloating?
item.description: Shift work wreaks havoc on your gut. Discover specific meal timing and strategic food choices that can repair your digestion and boost energy, even with chaotic schedules.

item.title: The Sleep Paradox: Why Trying to Sleep Keeps You Awake
item.description: Discover the frustrating truth: the harder you try to fall asleep, the more elusive it becomes. Learn to disengage from sleep anxiety and trust your body's natural rhythm.

item.title: Chronic Pain Won't Let You Sleep? A Field Manual for Relief
item.description: Trapped in the relentless loop where pain prevents sleep and sleeplessness intensifies pain? Discover specific sleep strategies that reprogram your brain's pain response.

item.title: Woke Up Drained? Damage Control for Athletes After Poor Sleep
item.description: Woke up exhausted before a crucial event? Learn immediate protocols and tactical adjustments athletes can implement to prevent injury, salvage performance, and optimize recovery after one night of inadequate sleep.

item.title: ADHD Brain Won't Shut Off? Why 'Winding Down' Fails
item.description: That 2 AM buzz? Discover why your ADHD brain resists sleep and learn counter-intuitive strategies to quiet the mental chatter for restful nights.

item.title: Beyond White Noise: Actively Guiding Your Brain to Deeper Sleep
item.description: Tired of white noise failing your anxious mind? Discover how scientifically engineered soundscapes actively guide your brain into truly restorative deep sleep.

item.title: Why Sunday Night Insomnia Steals Your Week, And How To Beat It
item.description: The dread of a sleepless Sunday night, fueled by work anxiety, can sabotage your entire week. Uncover the psychological triggers and implement a proactive wind-down routine to reclaim your sleep and Monday.

item.title: Why Does My Gut Wake Me Up at 3 AM? The Microbiome-Sleep Link
item.description: Persistent 3 AM wake-ups and restless nights might point to your gut. Discover how your microbiome dictates sleep quality and what specific steps can bring lasting rest.
